_meta.description: Questo file serve all'IA per ripristinare il contesto esatto dell'architettura, del database e delle regole di implementazione del progetto ArtAround.

project_core.name: ArtAround
project_core.goal: Visitare musei in maniera personalizzata e divertente.

tech_stack.frontend_admin: Alpine.js per reattività client-side, HTML servito dal backend

architecture_implementation.pattern: Strict MVC (Model-View-Controller) with separated Public/Private areas

public_frontend.behavior: Served statically by Express via app.use('/', express.static(...)). Contains CSS, client JS, and public HTML (login, index).

components.middleware: auth.js acts as The Guard. Uses jsonwebtoken (JWT).
components.controllers: The Brain. Extracts req data, calls Models, sends res (JSON or HTML).
components.routes: The Map. Express Router mapping endpoints to controllers.
components.views: The Vault. Protected HTML files (e.g., editor.html) NOT accessible publicly.

authentication_flow.middleware_logic: auth.js checks token. If missing/invalid -> redirect to /marketplace/login.html. If valid -> sets req.user and calls next().
authentication_flow.frontend_logic: Alpine.js fetches /api/check or decodes token to set isLoggedIn and permissions (x-show logic for UI).

api_data.flow: Router -> Auth Middleware -> AdminController.getStats -> Models count -> res.json({...})

project_extensions_targets.base_18_24: Marketplace, navigazione, TTS, comandi vocali base.
project_extensions_targets.ext_18_27: Visite sincronizzate docenti, contenuti privati, quiz finali.
project_extensions_targets.ext_18_33: Geolocalizzazione, LLM per generazione item, traduzione real-time, routing vocale naturale.
